description: Single screen where students record their daily achievement. Displays today's date, provides a text input field for entering an achievement (up to 150 characters), and handles saving with confirmation or blocking duplicate entries for the same day.

props.text: Single screen where students record their daily achievement. Displays today's date, provides a text input field for entering an achievement (up to 150 characters), and handles saving with confirmation or blocking duplicate entries for the same day.
Shows the current date to orient the student to which day they are recording for
Plain text input field that accepts up to 150 characters for the student to type their daily achievement
Displays remaining characters (e.g., '45/150') to help students stay within the 150-character limit
Button to submit the achievement entry, disabled when input is empty or exceeds 150 characters
Area that displays success confirmation with the saved achievement text after successful save
Area that displays a blocking message when a student attempts to save a second achievement for the same day
When an entry already exists for today, displays the saved achievement text with a message indicating today's win is already recorded, with input field disabled
